name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: The part of this role I'd be best at is the one you lead with: owning a customer's implementation from kickoff until Customer Success takes it over. At Wix I owned scope, budget, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio, carried up to 25 onboardings at once, and held 110% of my implementation target while leading onboarding teams of up to 30.

Before that, at Accelo, I sold project-management and billing software to professional-services firms and built the sequenced implementation plans the delivery team ran with. Today I run my own consulting practice, where I configure client systems and databases and build AI tools into delivery (LLM API calls, n8n and Zapier automations) so projects move faster without cutting corners.

To be direct: I haven't worked in energy or sustainability, and my titles haven't said Project Manager. The work has been project management, and a platform built on financial-grade utility data is the kind I learn fast. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
